description: This file is a C header file defining callback function prototypes for CAN Transport Protocol (CanTp) receive indication and transmission confirmation within an AUTOSAR-based automotive software project.

methods.name: CanTp_RxIndication
methods.description: Callback function invoked upon receiving a CAN TP PDU, with parameters for the PDU ID and data.

methods.name: CanTp_TxConfirmation
methods.description: Callback function invoked upon transmission confirmation of a CAN TP PDU, with parameter for the PDU ID.
